rules: Developmental diagnosis of the published experiment, not a new confirmatory benchmark.
Reuse all 262144 original uniformly random two-edge source attempts and their empirical query errors. No IMP, teacher support, or target observations enter source-bank selection.
Keep the original heldout card assignment. Change only the source query threshold. Final target success remains population MSE below 0.1.
The 0.1 prior is the frozen published checkpoint. Other priors use the same MADE, optimizer, seeds, steps, and source validation NLL selection.
Aggregate duplicate masks with their original frequencies: the weighted full-batch likelihood is the same as on all accepted cards. This is not uniform reweighting of unique masks.
Enumerate all 65536 binary masks to diagnose probability mass; teacher masks are used only for labeled diagnostics.
Choose threshold and temperature by empirical query on the original calibration functions and pairs. Retain all three prior seeds.
Evaluate new numerical functions only after the calibration choice is saved. The structural split is already known from the previous experiment, so this remains development evidence.
Keep the original 64-fit budget, optimizer settings, query selection, and fresh numerical initialization for every method.
Report when formerly unseen masks enter a relaxed bank. Distinguish learning from partial source solutions from generation of masks absent from the new bank.
Preserve the published run and its original source snapshots. New diagnostics use a separate directory. No test suite.
